parts.text: What is the policy on maternity leave duration, and what are the expense limits for daily meals and host gifts when traveling on business?
Maternity leave is up to 24 weeks for employees (16 weeks for interns) under Section 2.1. Business meal limit is $120/day under Section 4.4, and host gifts are up to $50/day under Section 4.3.
